messages:
incident-bot: P0 alert — spike in 401s from auth provider in eu-west-2. Detecting token verification failures for both console and API traffic. Pager sent to oncall. :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): seeing it, thanks. hit rates: 401_upstream 18% -> 65% over last 3m for /api/* and /console/*

ben (sre): logs show `jwks_fetch_error` and `kid mismatch` from our verifier. Example: `ERR JWT verify failed: invalid signature (kid=abc123)`

carla (eng): I can reproduce locally hitting the introspect endpoint — Okta returns 200 but the JWKS thumbprint doesn't match the kid in tokens. suspect cert rotation or stale JWKS cache at edge CDN.

alice (oncall): initial mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback to cached public keys (if available) 2) route console traffic to fallback auth proxy 3) page Okta status and SRE on-call for vendor. doing step 1 now.

opsbot: executed: `service auth-verifier set --jwks-fallback=enabled --ttl-cache=86400` by alice (oncall) at 2234567085

david (support): customer reports incoming. Major customers impacted: BrightCorp (console login failure), Nimbus Health (API 401 spikes). Support status page updated -> https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2234567 :white_flag:

carla (eng): rolling a config change to enable permissive verification for tokens issued within last 48h (soft-fail on kid mismatch) — this is temporary. patch: 
```
# permissive jwt toggle
REDWOOD_JWT_PERMISSIVE=true
REDWOOD_JWT_PERMISSIVE_WINDOW=48h
```
Applying to eu-west-2 pool now.

alice (oncall): confirm deploy started -> `deploy auth-verifier:permissive-v1 -> eu-west-2` at 2234567120

ben (sre): watch: permissive reduces failures but increases risk of accepting rotated tokens before final verification. We'll enable strict monitoring and trace any fallback-accepted tokens. Added rule to trace `permissive_accepted=true` events.

incident-bot: Okta status page shows a partial JWKS propagation issue in eu-west-2, status: Investigating — https://status.okta.example/incidents/8492 :link:

marie (product): what's customer impact window estimate? we need messaging for enterprise customers and potential rollback plan.

david (support): ETA unknown. I'm drafting a message: "We're seeing intermittent login failures due to third-party auth provider key propagation. Workaround implemented; sessions may need re-login. We're monitoring and will update in 15 minutes." sending to customer ops now. :email:

carla (eng): I'm prepping an additional mitigation: bypass remote introspect for short-lived sessions by validating only signature+exp locally with permissive kid logic, then queue a background introspect to fully validate once JWKS updates.

alice (oncall): implement that only in eu-west-2. add rate limit to background introspect to avoid hammering Okta.

ben (sre): implemented rate limit -> `introspect_bg_rate=10/s` and exponential backoff. Also added circuit breaker: if Okta 5xx > 5% for 2m, stop bg introspects.

incident-bot: metric: overall 401 rate down from 65% -> 12% after permissive toggle and jwks-fallback. Console sessions recovering but some API keys still 401.

david (support): updated status page with mitigation note and list of affected customers. Sent proactive emails to BrightCorp and Nimbus Health.

carla (eng): Okta update shows they pushed a hotfix for JWKS propagation at 2234567320. We should start reverting permissive flags once we confirm stable JWKS.

alice (oncall): scaling back now: disabling REDWOOD_JWT_PERMISSIVE on eu-west-2 -> starting at 2234567360. Will leave jwks-fallback enabled for 10m to smooth.

opsbot: executed: `service auth-verifier set --jwks-fallback=enabled --remove-permissive=true` by alice (oncall) at 2234567375

ben (sre): monitoring traces: permissive_accepted=0 after revert. No regression in 4m. 401s falling to baseline (~2%).

marie (product): good — prepping postmortem note and customer summary. Action items: 1) add automated detection for JWKS kid skew 2) add fallback circuit with safe default 3) run runbook drill 4) update runbook with vendor contact flow.

alice (oncall): handing off to next oncall @ben for follow-up and postmortem. Handoff notes: permissive toggles used, jwks-fallback left ON for 10m, customer comms sent, Okta fixed propagation.

ben (sre): taking. I'll collect traces and prepare incident timeline + SLO impact calc. Moving thread to incident-complete when finished. :white_check_mark:
